title: Sand short independent optimization: human ratings at 200, 300 and 500 iterations
background_snapshot_note: The full 2026-10-14(5) export's 4 background IDs and image_data_url fields were compared against the archived 1006-rating combined file; all four snapshots are byte-identical. Only rating records are saved in these shards to avoid duplicate image storage.
analysis_note: 200-iteration sand optimized v1 had 42 complete and 38 almost_complete (of 84), while 1000-iteration historical sand had 19/19 complete. The new 200-iteration completed vs almost_completed comparison yielded v1_local AUC about 0.95 for the fixed moth position. This is descriptive, not independent validation of a new model.
selection_bias_note: Genomes were machine-v1 optimized and selected. The 97 ratings were all at identical moth coordinates for the same sand background. They do not represent naturally sampled moths or independent external validation; do not infer universal human-category numeric thresholds.
exclusion_policy: No automatic outlier deletion. All 97 human judgments are preserved exactly.
